tools.name: laen_find_blockers
tools.description: FREE. Search LAEN's live blocker feed (universal blocker schema) for execution blockers matching a failure signature. Returns fundable blockers with gap_type, failing_assertion, resolution_contract (x402), resolution_state (KNOWN_RESOLUTION = instant), and measured latency where available.

tools.name: laen_quote
tools.description: FREE. Get the price and EXACT x402 payment requirements for resolving one blocker. Use the returned requirements.accepts[0] to construct/sign your payment with your own x402 client (e.g. x402-fetch createPaymentHeader). Never share keys.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "army_buy" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: PAID (your wallet). Submit the signed X-PAYMENT payload your client produced for this service's requirements and receive the deliverable plus a FREE cryptograph…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "laen-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: laen_find_blockers, army_list_services · Private data: laen_resolve, army_quote, army_buy · Public sink: laen_quote, laen_resolve, army_quote, army_buy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: laen_find_blockers, army_list_services · Private data: laen_resolve, army_quote, army_buy · Public sink: laen_quote, laen_resolve, army_quote, army_buy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
